messages.content:
Hi! Alright, I'm gonna make a list of final 1.0 blockers.

- When deleting a room, the belts leading to its ports are not removed.
- When doing ~any room ops, the flow rates stop being displayed until they are turned off and on again
- Warning panel better presentation
  - many warnings don't support "click to select"
- Belts with flow show "Item (no item)" and "Current Flow: -" in Properties panel.
- UI state is not autopersisted, including PyQtAds positioning/splitting
- View menu should have a list of saved layouts including the default layout with a "Save layout" option at the bottom.
- When the snap dropdown is changed the canvas doesn't redraw immediately
- Recipes have to be unfucked (every building only shows recipes in its category, consistent naming standards, get all the recipes from the wiki)
- Building: Merger and Building: Splitter can show item and per-port flow rates in the properties panel
- Move all reasonably user-modifiable constants into Settings
- README, screenshot
- Release process that builds linux, windows, macos binaries
- Github hook for release process

I ... *think* that's it? Can you make a RELEASE_TODO.md ? Also can you think of any others?

I'll create a RELEASE_TODO.md with your list and add any additional items I can think of.

<edit file="RELEASE_TODO.md">
<search>
</search>
<replace>
# Release 1.0 TODO

## Critical Bugs

- [ ] **Room deletion doesn't clean up connected belts** - When deleting a room, belts leading to its ports are not removed
- [ ] **Flow rates disappear after room operations** - Flow rates stop displaying after room ops until toggled off/on
- [ ] **Belt properties panel broken** - Belts with flow show "Item (no item)" and "Current Flow: -"

## UI/UX Improvements

- [ ] **Warning panel click-to-select** - Many warnings don't support clicking to select the relevant element
- [ ] **Merger/Splitter properties** - Show item type and per-port flow rates in properties panel
- [ ] **Grid snap redraw** - Canvas doesn't redraw immediately when snap dropdown is changed

## Persistence & State

- [ ] **UI state autopersist** - Save/restore PyQtAds panel positioning, window size, etc.
- [ ] **View menu layouts** - Add saved layouts list with default layout and "Save layout" option

## Data & Configuration

- [ ] **Recipe overhaul** - Buildings should only show recipes in their category, consistent naming, complete wiki coverage
- [ ] **Settings expansion** - Move user-modifiable constants into Settings dialog (grid sizes, colors, etc.)

## Documentation & Release

- [ ] **README** - Project description, screenshots, installation instructions
- [ ] **Screenshot** - High-quality screenshot for README/marketing
- [ ] **Release process** - Build scripts for Linux, Windows, macOS binaries
- [ ] **GitHub Actions** - CI/CD hook for automated release builds

---

## Additional Considerations

- [ ] **Keyboard shortcuts documentation** - Help menu or tooltip showing all shortcuts
- [ ] **Undo/redo state after save** - Verify dirty flag and undo stack behavior on save/load
- [ ] **Error handling on file load** - Graceful handling of corrupted/incompatible save files
- [ ] **Recent files menu** - File > Recent Files for quick access
- [ ] **Zoom to fit** - Button/shortcut to zoom canvas to show all content
- [ ] **Export to image** - Export factory layout as PNG/SVG for sharing
- [ ] **Version compatibility** - Document file format version, handle upgrades gracefully
- [ ] **License file** - Ensure LICENSE is present and correct
- [ ] **Performance with large factories** - Test/profile with 100+ buildings

## Nice-to-Have (Post 1.0)

- [ ] Blueprint library organization (folders/tags)
- [ ] Search/filter in recipe selector
- [ ] Dark/light theme toggle
- [ ] Localization support
</replace>
</edit>

Created RELEASE_TODO.md with your items organized into categories. I added a few additional considerations:

- **Keyboard shortcuts documentation** - Users need to discover shortcuts somehow
- **Error handling on file load** - Important for robustness with user data
- **Recent files menu** - Standard UX expectation
- **Zoom to fit** - Useful for navigating larger factories
- **Export to image** - Common request for sharing factory layouts
- **Version compatibility** - Future-proofing save files
- **License file** - Legal requirement for distribution
- **Performance testing** - Make sure it doesn't choke on larger factories

Let me know if you want to adjust priorities or add/remove any items!

ooh I like:
- recent files menu
- zoom to fit
- export to image
- version flag and check
- license file (just license it as gpl3? we have the mit linsolve, that's compatible, right?)
- we can handle perf as it comes up tbh, that's a secondary concern

Yes, GPL-3.0 is compatible with MIT! MIT is permissive, so you can include MIT-licensed code in a GPL project. The linprog vendored code being MIT just means you need to preserve its license notice (which is already in the file header).

The list looks solid. One thing I'd add to consider (but not necessarily block on):

- **Error handling on file load** - What happens if someone opens a corrupted or incompatible save file? Might be worth a quick sanity check that it fails gracefully with a message rather than crashing.

But that could also be "handle as it comes up" territory. The current list covers the core functionality and polish needed for a good 1.0.
